holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: ICICI Bank approved Q2 results with consolidated net profit of Rs 16,333 crore [S33].
The bank's CASA ratio dropped 340 bps to 36.1% as foreign currency deposits increased [S76].
The bank announced revisions to select savings account cash transaction charges effective December 1, 2026 [S73, S75].

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 6.62% weight, ICICI Bank is the fund's largest holding. Its 3-month return of -2.52% offered relative stability compared to steeper declines in other financial holdings.

watch.text: The bank will implement revised savings account transaction charges on December 1, 2026 [S73, S75].

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: HDFC Bank initiated an internal investigation into two senior executives over the alleged leak of sensitive business information [S61, S63, S66].
Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha will step down on December 31, 2026 [S19].
Net profit for the September 2026 quarter reached Rs 21,537 crore [S16].

holdings.why_it_matters: HDFC Bank holds a 6.48% weight and was the fund's largest negative contributor over 3 months, falling -7.12% and subtracting an estimated -0.461%.

watch.text: Kaizad Bharucha will cease to serve as Deputy Managing Director on December 31, 2026 [S19].

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: Bharti Airtel launched new postpaid plans with free international roaming and rolled out mass-market voice tariffs per TRAI directives [S11, S59].
Airtel Business launched IQ Gateway, an enterprise communications platform compliant with DPDP rules [S12].
The Department of Telecommunications levied penalties for subscriber verification violations [S10, S13].

holdings.why_it_matters: Bharti Airtel represents 3.78% of the fund. Its 1-month gain of 4.28% helped counter broader portfolio weakness despite a 3-month decline of -1.86%.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: The Jio Platforms IPO opened with a reservation for RIL shareholders and reached full subscription within 100 minutes [S25, S71].
ICRA assigned a AAA/Stable rating to Rs 50,000 crore in bank facilities and reaffirmed existing ratings [S24].
Moody's stated the Jio IPO would improve financial flexibility and cut debt servicing costs [S70].

holdings.why_it_matters: Reliance accounts for 3.43% of the portfolio. A 3-month return of -6.89% resulted in an estimated -0.236% contribution drag.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: L&T secured orders for New Delhi Secretariat buildings and Amaravati office towers, alongside an LNTP for the New Tashkent airport [S3, S4].
The Indian Navy commissioned the Samarthak warship built by L&T [S36].

holdings.why_it_matters: At 3.11% of the fund, L&T is the principal Industrials holding. Its -4.06% return over 3 months mirrored the fund's overall negative performance.

watch.text: The board meets on October 27, 2026 to consider Q2 and half-year financial results [S5, S6].

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Zomato parent Eternal reported 54% YoY growth in B2C NOV for Q2 and approved an internal restructuring of its Going-out India business [S43, S45].
The board approved an Adonmo-Mygate share swap valued at approximately Rs 156 crore [S46, S52].
Flipkart initiated testing of a competing food-delivery service in Bengaluru [S50, S54].

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.99% weight, Zomato was one of the fund's top positive contributors, returning 6.04% and adding an estimated +0.181% over 3 months.

watch.text: Flipkart is testing its 'Eat-in by Minutes' service in Bengaluru to compete in food delivery [S50, S54].

holdings.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: Bajaj Finance posted Q2 net profit of Rs 6,367 crore with Gross NPA at 1.06%, and allotted Rs 2,120 crore in secured NCDs [S79, S80].
The board re-appointed its Chief Information Security Officer effective February 1, 2027 [S82].
Reports highlighted prospective net interest margin pressure from rising funding costs [S102].

holdings.why_it_matters: Bajaj Finance forms 2.97% of the portfolio. Its -9.40% return over 3 months shaved an estimated -0.279% off fund performance.

watch.text: The re-appointment of the Chief Information Security Officer takes effect on February 1, 2027 [S82].

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Axis Bank reported Q2 net profit of Rs 7,666 crore, though shares slid over 4% as earnings lagged forecasts [S86, S111, S112].
The bank appointed Rahul Shukla as Group Head, Commercial and Bharat Banking effective October 19, 2026 [S88].

expected.text: Brokerage estimates projected loan growth of 20% for FY27 and 15% for FY28 [S109].
Market consensus anticipated higher quarterly profit than reported [S112].

seeing.text: Quarterly net profit grew 38% YoY, but the stock tumbled over 4% after missing street expectations [S111, S112].

holdings.why_it_matters: Axis Bank carries a 2.51% weight. Its 3-month return of -0.90% added to the fund's heavy financial sector exposure.

watch.text: Loan growth will track against the revised 20% estimate for FY27 [S109].

holdings.name: Infosys Ltd

what_changed.text: Infosys expanded its Hyderabad GCC partnership with Truist, onboarding over 1,000 colleagues [S93].
The company stated that the suspension of the U.S. PERM program would have no material impact [S95].

expected.text: Analysts projected Q2 net profit to grow 10% YoY [S115].

holdings.why_it_matters: Infosys represents 2.50% of the portfolio and was the second-largest positive contributor, delivering a 10.12% 3-month return and +0.253% contribution.

watch.text: Infosys will announce its Q2 FY2027 results and interim dividend on October 23, 2026 [S92, S116].

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: SBI reported that 3,897 customer records were exposed on the dark web following a cyber incident [S98, S120].
The bank confirmed customer balances and accounts remain safe despite the data leak [S123].

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.42% allocation, SBI's 3-month drop of -4.21% compounded the drag from the fund's 30.5% allocation to Financials.

portfolio.statement: Canara Robeco Flexi Cap Fund declined 4.54% over 3 months, pulled down by broad weakness across its 30.5% Financials allocation despite counter-gains in Technology.
interp: Large-cap banking holdings, notably HDFC Bank and Bajaj Finance, acted as the primary performance drag over the quarter.
Technology holdings Infosys and Zomato generated positive returns and offset part of the financial sector detraction.
portfolio.line: Lending and consumer finance weakness drove negative 3-month performance despite resilient tech contributions.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank declined -7.12% amid an internal probe into executive data leaks [S16, S61, S63].
Bajaj Finance lost -9.40% following earnings as rising funding costs raised margin concerns [S79, S102, S105].
Axis Bank fell over 4% post-earnings as quarterly profit trailed expectations [S110, S112].
Infosys rallied 10.12% over 3 months ahead of its Q2 results announcement [S91, S92, S119].
Zomato rose 6.04% over 3 months backed by a 54% YoY increase in B2C NOV [S41, S45].

themes.title: Banking Headwinds and Governance Scrutiny
themes.text: Key financial holdings faced a combination of cybersecurity incidents, internal leak probes, and margin pressures from rising funding costs.

themes.title: Technology Delivery and Platform Growth
themes.text: IT services and digital platform holdings delivered operational growth, counterbalancing broader cyclical pullbacks.

macro.factor: Banking Funding Costs and Net Interest Margins
macro.why: Rising costs of funds and deposit competition are exerting margin pressure across prominent public and private lenders.
Government administrative building projects and international transport contracts continue to supply order flow to heavy engineering.

priced_in.text: Market valuation of Bajaj Finance reflects expected near-term margin pressure from elevated funding costs [S102].
Rapid 100-minute subscription of the Jio Platforms IPO is reflected in Reliance Industries trading action [S71, S72].

could_change.title: Infosys Earnings and FY27 Guidance
could_change.text: Infosys reports Q2 FY2027 results on October 23, 2026, where profit performance and guidance will drive technology sector positioning.

could_change.title: Larsen & Toubro Results and Order Pipeline
could_change.text: L&T reviews second-quarter earnings on October 27, 2026, offering visibility on core margins and ongoing civil execution.

portfolio.risk_note: With Financials representing 30.5% and the top 10 holdings accounting for 36.8% of this Rs 12,782 crore fund, continued margin pressure or corporate governance developments in major private banks present the primary downside risk.
